verdict.rationale: Stripe documents the monitoring building blocks: webhooks and event destinations push real-time account events, Smart Retries automatically retries failed payments, and recovery analytics surfaces recent failures. The hosted MCP server also gives an agent scoped read/write access to invoices, PaymentIntents and subscriptions. However, the evidence never explicitly ties webhook events to payment failures, Smart Retries is framed as automatic and no-code rather than agent-driven, and nothing documents dunning outreach. Missing for 10: explicit failed-payment/invoice-failure webhook events, a documented agent-driven retry API (e.g. re-attempting invoice payment), dunning email/outreach capabilities, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running this workflow.
